description.value: Honey Grove is a woman-owned artisan bakery in central Courtenay specializing in slow-fermented, small-batch sourdough breads and pastries crafted with certified organic Canadian flour, some milled to order on Vancouver Island. Their curated menu spans named sourdough loaves, baguettes, croissants, savoury items, seasonal pies, and frozen products available for in-store pickup or pre-order. The bakery also operates stalls at the Saturday Comox Valley and Sunday Campbell River farmer's markets through the summer season.
